text: ①じたくに　おいてある　パソコンに　むかって　Ａボタンを　おします。

structure.jp: ①じたくに　おいてある　パソコンに　むかって
structure.en: ① face the PC that has been put in your home, and

structure.jp: Ａボタンを　おします。

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did it earlier and the result is still there. おいてある = 'has been put there'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: じたくに　おいてある　パソコン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing tells you which one is meant. じたくに　おいてある　パソコン = 'the PC that has been put in your home'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next one, like 'and'. むかって = 'face it and'.
